# Show users how long they have to recover an unsaved draft

## What & Why
Users currently learn about an unsaved draft through a notice, but they cannot tell how much recovery time remains. A visible countdown or similarly clear time cue would make the recovery window easier to act on.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity draft notices show the remaining recovery time without relying on color alone
- The time cue updates while the notice is visible and disappears when recovery expires
- Browser coverage verifies the time cue for both draft types
